# NOTES ON THE TWO BOOKS (for later Q&A; use instead of source text)

## BOOK 1 of 2: "The Princess of the Atom" by Ray Cummings (1929; Avon reprint 1950)

**Dedication:** to Hal (son) and Russ (son-in-law), both chemists.
**Blurb:** Giants off New England; Dianne returns from oblivion; Frank Ferrule's journey into smallness; Drake vs. Togaro "who would rule the universe." Togaro = "Atomic Napoleon."

**Prologue (Frank narrates; 17 yrs old):**
- Family: father (consulting chemist, Dr. Ferrule, ~50, iron-gray hair, horn-rimmed spectacles, thin studious face); brother Drake (6 yrs older, 6'2", blond, "huge dog"); sister Dianne (blue eyes, flaxen hair as child; later pale-gold hair, cameo-like beauty); Frank small, slender, dark hair, "terrier." Mother died when Frank was a child.
- Summer home on Maine coast, King's Cove. Bird's Nest Island: ~2 miles offshore, few hundred acres, 50-ft rock peak, spring of fresh water, gulls, childhood signal fire (two large puffs then three smaller).
- Aug 14: Dianne vanishes on island (clothes left on beach). Frank had grabbed her hair at forehead; her hair grows in a peak, parted to one side, she dislikes it touched.
- Father's revelation: Dianne was a foundling found ~15 yrs earlier (when Drake ~8, Frank ~2) on Bird's Nest Island as ~1-yr-old infant, wrapped in a golden gossamer hooded robe; crescent-moon silver scar on forehead under peak of hair.
- Father: "wondered if she were just exactly human."
- Chapter I: First giant reported off Cape Sable, NS, March 20 (steamship out of Halifax, bound Portland). Giants seen off Maine coast late March; Frank is an International Mail Service pilot (Boston–St. John). Frank and pilot Bob Jones (relief) + radio operator Green fly patrol. Giant at cove near King's Cove kills people on cliff with arm sweep; giant shrinks and swims to Bird's Nest Island, dives, vanishes. Father's telegram: "He has heard from Dianne."
- Chapter II: Midnight visitor at Westchester home (Drake and father). Tall bulky man, hairless heavy jaw, foreign accent, bullet head pale-gold hair, slate-blue eyes, hat worn backward; says "You will never see Dianne again. Forget her." Warns to stay away from Maine.
- Chapter III: Frank and Drake guard Maine house (Elton two miles away, troops, military law). Dawn: smoke signal from Bird's Nest Island using childhood signal.
- Chapter IV–V: Island; Dianne (tiny, with companion **Ahlma**, "her servant and friend," pale silver-white robe, paler crescent) grows back to size. Dianne's world is within an atom of rock on Bird's Nest Island; "Mita" planet. Dianne's parents spirited her away from conqueror; Togaro (her former suitor/enemy, learned English from her) wants throne and her. Father: "lads, bring the atom fragment here; guard it." Togaro appears in room as tiny man; flees.
- Chapter VI–VIII: Frank & Drake take pellets (drug; diminishes; antidote enlarges; belt with vials), chase Togaro into smallness in cellular caverns; Drake grows and fights Togaro; both fall through roof opening; Togaro attacks father and Ahlma in room. Drake returns; they return to island; giants appear in storm; battle with planes/battleship; giants killed. Dianne and Drake dwindle. Frank chips off fragment of meteorite (pitted, copper-colored, buried under ferns by signal fire) with claspknife, is found by men.
- Chapter IX–X: One year later at King's Cove; fragment guarded in barred room (granite slab, microscope, guards: Foley, Ransome). May night: tiny man Alt (from Drake) with white flag. Alt says he is "friend from Drake"; carries drugs belt; needs guide.
- Chapter XI–XII: Frank goes in with Alt (bathing suit, four automatics, knives, drug belt). Father lifts them onto slab. Frank feels tug at shoelace/insect crawl (Togaro riding him). Giant Togaro man ambushes in crescent pit; Frank fires automatic; giant wounded. Drake reunion at red light signal, Dianne kisses Frank.
- Chapter XIII–XIV: Interplanetary vehicle (wire-woven cage). Togaro is a stowaway; murders guard with bodkin; locks Dianne in cabin; forces drug on Dianne; ship lands plan.
- Chapter XV–XVI: Togaro holds Dianne in cabin, threatens: enlarging pellet in mouth; Frank's plan: shrink, go under door to attack.
- Chapter XVII–XVIII: Frank shrinks to 1 inch, rides on Togaro's belt. Togaro takes enlarging drug, bursts ceiling, leaps out with Dianne; ship lands on Mita at night.
- Chapter XIX–XXII: Mita night in Shore City; Jain (official), palace of Dianne; mob; Drake & Ahlma. Togaro on island; Frank rides Togaro; Dianne in Togaro's cabin; Frank climbs rope; Togaro "Vengeance of Togaro!"
- Chapter XXIII–XXIV: Togaro pushes Mita into the sun; Mita destroyed; Drake/Ahlma/Alt evacuate ~110,000 Mitans to vehicle.
- Chapter XXV–XXVI: Togarite horde (~40,000) goes out through atom; Frank in disguise; Frank saves Dianne briefly, strikes Togaro with rock. Frank and Dianne flee; black-and-white flag signal; reunion; discover rock stolen by Togarites.
- Chapter XXVII–XXIX: Fight on rock summit (Alt wounded). Stolen rock: Togaro's men took it; Foley killed; father knocked out; rock is in Togarite hands (hiding at King's Cove boathouse).
- Chapter XXX–XXXII: May 21: giants rise at King's Cove; world panics; Togarites occupy territory; giant lines advance south; battleship sunk by Togaro near Cape Cod; Canadian planes shot down by slings. Frank & Dianne escape; drive; Dianne runs away and grows.
- Chapter XXXIII–XXXIV: Togaro in NY harbor; Frank & Dianne fight; Togaro poisons himself after throwing the rock globe into sea (rock destroyed). Drake defeats giants; Togaro's body sunk. Epilogue: cottage by sea; Dianne "princess of our little cottage"; signal fire for Drake and Ahlma.

Key characters: Frank Ferrule (narrator), Drake Ferrule, Dianne, Dr. Ferrule (father), Ahlma (Mitan girl, pale crescent), Togaro (bullet head, pale-gold hair, slate-blue eyes), Alt, Jain, Foley, Ransome, Bob Jones, Green.

## BOOK 2 of 2: "'Gainst the Might of Spain: A Story of the Days of the Great Armada" by Percy F. Westerman (Pilgrim Press, London)

**Narrator:** Ralph Roy, born 6 July 1568, Crofton, Hampshire. Later knighted "Sir Ralph Roy."
**Father:** Richard Roy, Queen's pilot (Titchfield Haven); as a pilot brought Philip of Spain's ship into Southampton (Mary's wedding). Voyage to Spanish Main with Don Iago d'Alvarez and Don José da Silva; silver mine of San Luis (Mexico, Rio del Foy); father drove mules over ravine; returned 1566.
- Father's disappearance: night in 1580-ish; "Speedie" of Brixham (galeas of Cadiz); taken to Spain; tortured; Escurial/King Philip.
- Mother; Ralph bound apprentice to Captain Hannibal Cleat (5 pounds) at 14.

**Chapter list:** I Pilot Who Did Not Return; II Damsel of Lyme; III Captain Hannibal Cleat; IV Jack Staynton; V Captain Cleat in His True Colours; VI Pirate in Spite of Myself; VII Catching a Tartar; VIII Captured!; IX Don Iago d'Alvarez; X Aboard the San Josef; XI Inquisition; XII Torture-Chamber; XIII Escape; XIV Timely Rescue; XV Off to Spanish Main; XVI Mountain Pass; XVII Bringing Back the Silver; XVIII At Bay; XIX Taking of Galleon; XX Bringing in Prize; XXI Great Armada; XXII English Dogs and Spanish Bulls; XXIII Fireships; XXIV Last of Damsel of Lyme; XXV In Queen's Presence.

**Key events & names:**
- Pinnace *Damsel of Lyme* (49 ft, ~21 tons), seized by Vice-Admiral Horsey; auctioned June 29, 1582 (Mayor John Highfield); bought by Cleat for £34. Sir Henry Radclyffe (Governor); Roger Staynton (master-gunner); son Jack Staynton (2 yrs older than Ralph, broad, stowaway in cabin hold; later privateer on *Nonsuch*).
- Cleat: pirate; crew convicts from *Nonsuch*; boy Dick Buzza (Padstow, from sloop *Jane*); Cleat's mate James; sailor "Old Garge"; wounded in galleon fight; mad; attempted to blow powder magazine; died by suicide-like collapse; body sunk.
- Spanish galleon *San José*/*San Josef*; Don Iago d'Alvarez demands chart; Inquisition at Spanish prison (cell No. 19); father and Ralph escape, galley-fight, rescued by *Nonsuch* (Roger Staynton, Jack).
- Mine of San Luis (Huitzel volcano); mountain pass; silver brought back; Jenkins rescued; Coombes (mate, Bosham); Skelton; Roberts; battle on isthmus; Ralph wounded (leg, head).
- Captured galleon *Sol del Esto* (Don José da Silva killed).
- 1588 Armada: Sir Thomas Slingsby (Bramdean) joins; Pilot Thomas Fleming (Scots pirate; pardoned); pinnace *Pride of Saltash* topmast; Drake's squadron; fireships. Damsel of Lyme sent as fireship (Ralph, Jack, Slingsby wounded); Lord Howard of Effingham; Captain Prowse; Captain Young; Don Pedro Valdez surrender to Drake's *Revenge*.
- Ralph carries news to Queen Elizabeth; knighted; Don Iago d'Alvarez seen chained in galley at Bordeaux (captured, condemned to galleys).
